d:
Watch India’s final clash against Argentina in the FIH Pro League 2025-26.
Argentina set the tone early, playing with sharp intent and clinical finishing to take control of the first half. Two well-worked goals gave the visitors a 2-0 lead at the break, putting India on the back foot heading into halftime.
The second half began much like the first, with Argentina striking again to extend their advantage. Two more goals saw them surge to a commanding 4-0 lead by the 49th minute, capitalizing on key opportunities and maintaining pressure in the attacking circle.
